name: hikma-portfolio
description: Only needed if you change Tailwind classes in index.html. Run from the dev folder: npm install, then npm run build

scripts.build: cd .. && npx tailwindcss -c dev/tailwind.config.js -i dev/tailwind.input.css -o css/tailwind.css --minify
